journal_lines: Drowned rising from the water. Put it back.
Came up from the aquifer. Dealt with.
Trident. Different from the unarmed ones.
The water here is cold and they were in it waiting.
Came up through a flooded cave floor.
Two of them, both armed. Held the bank.
Slow on land, fast in water. Stayed on land.
The current brought it right to me.
It held its breath longer than I did. Eventually surfaced.
Grabbed the leg from below the water's edge. Reacted.
Three in the flooded corridor. Moved through quickly.
The tide brought them in. The tide went back. They didn't.
Waited at the bank. They emerged. Dealt with them on dry ground.
Coral around it. The reef kind.
